svg.title: With Syfert's tools, misgrounded citations fall to 2–6% for every model tested

cc:Work.dc:title: With Syfert's tools, misgrounded citations fall to 2–6% for every model tested
cc:Work.dc:description: Sonnet 5 + Syfert: misgrounded 1.9%, fabricated 0.8% of 265 cites; Gemma 4 26B local + Syfert: misgrounded 2.8%, fabricated 0.7% of 289 cites; DeepSeek 4.1 Flash + Syfert: misgrounded 4.0%, fabricated 0.0% of 278 cites; Qwen 3.8 Flash + Syfert: misgrounded 5.7%, fabricated 3.4% of 263 cites; Claude Opus 5.5: misgrounded 5.4%, fabricated 0.4% of 560 cites; GPT-6 Astra: misgrounded 6.9%, fabricated 0.0% of 217 cites; Claude Fable 5.1: misgrounded 7.4%, fabricated 0.4% of 755 cites; DeepSeek 4.1 Flash: misgrounded 15.7%, fabricated 3.9% of 102 cites; Qwen 3.8 Max: misgrounded 18.2%, fabricated 29.9% of 335 cites; Gemini 3.1 Pro: misgrounded 22.7%, fabricated 4.1% of 317 cites; Gemini 3.8 Flash: misgrounded 28.2%, fabricated 2.7% of 110 cites; DeepSeek 4 Pro: misgrounded 39.9%, fabricated 5.6% of 233 cites; Gemma 4 26B local: misgrounded 49.3%, fabricated 62.0% of 276 cites; Qwen 3.8 Flash: misgrounded 54.6%, fabricated 55.2% of 183 cites

g.text: With Syfert's tools, misgrounded citations fall to 2–6% for every model tested

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Misgrounded = wrong case name or a quote not in the opinion, share of all citations; fabricated = citation resolves to no case.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Bare: 150 questions (Flash models 60 or 40); + Syfert: 55–150 graded answers. Preliminary, Sept 22 2026.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781
